text: Rose Da Silva's adopted daughter Sharon sleepwalks and dreams of Silent Hill, a West Virginia town abandoned to a coal seam fire, so Rose [drives her there for answers|trigger|travelling somewhere remote]. After a crash Sharon is gone, and Rose wanders a town [wrapped in fog that suddenly gives way to a nightmare world of monsters|rules|reality comes apart]. She learns of Alessa, [a girl burned as a witch by the town's fanatical cult|wrong|harm done to children], whose face Sharon shares, and [whose rage has never cooled|wants|revenge for a wrong].
